title: Great audiotour!
text:
One of the best ways to explore Montjuïc. It offers very interesting facts, the narration is captivating, and you can go through it at your own pace.
Highly recommended!
author: Bladimir_H

title: Wonderful experiencia.
text: What a wonderful experience! I absolutely loved this Montjuïc audio guide because it combines history, culture, and spectacular views of Barcelona in a very entertaining way. It’s perfect for exploring Montjuïc at your own pace and enjoying it however you like.
author: Lucas_P

title: Predictable, convenient, and well organized
text:
In our case, everything went very well. The audio guide worked without any problems, and there were no difficulties. In the end, everything went exactly as we expected, and we were left with a very good impression.
P.S. The description also always makes it clear to me what is included in the price and which tickets need to be purchased separately.
author: P117PTnatalien

title: Montjuie
text: We walked up to Mont juie from La Rambla…quite a hike… the tour helped complement the walking around
author: Rose_B

title: A mountain of history and beauty!
text: The audio guide for Montjuïc from TouringBee is excellent. It provides in-depth information on the rich history and beauties of Montjuïc Hill. From the castle to the beautiful gardens, the guide covers everything with engaging stories and easy-to-follow directions. It made my visit much more enriching. Perfect for anyone wanting to fully appreciate what Montjuïc has to offer.
author: R4000SQsofiar
